title: Factorization of a Gowers cube product
statement: Let $F$ assign a real-valued function on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ to each point of $\mathbb{F}_2^{k+1}$, let $i\in\{0,\ldots,k\}$, and let $x,h\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ and $y_1,\ldots,y_k\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The product over $s\in\mathbb{F}_2^{k+1}$ of $F(s)$ evaluated at $x+\sum_{j=1}^{k+1}s_j y'_j$, where $y'$ is obtained by inserting $h$ into $y$ at position $i$, equals the product of the two half-cube products: the slice with inserted coordinate $0$ based at $x$, times the slice with inserted coordinate $1$ based at $x+h$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued family $F$ indexed by $(k+1)$-bit strings and points of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$
